title: 面试

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：My background is in [field], specifically [focus area]. What that means in practice is [real-world impact].
sentenceFrames.usage: 自我介绍。"Tell me about yourself" 的满分回答结构。
sentenceFrames.example: My background is in marketing, specifically content strategy. What that means in practice is I help companies figure out what to say and how to say it so people actually want to listen.
substitutions: My background is in _____, specifically _____. What that means in practice is _____.
I've spent the last _____ years working in _____. My main focus has been _____.
你的真实版本：My background is in _____. What that means in practice is _____.

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：One challenge I faced was [situation]. What I did was [action]. And the result was [outcome].
sentenceFrames.usage: 回答行为面试题（"Tell me about a time you..."）。这就是 STAR 法的口语版。
sentenceFrames.example: One challenge I faced was that our team was consistently missing deadlines. What I did was set up a simple tracking system and a 10-minute daily check-in. The result was we hit every deadline for the next 6 months — and people actually liked the new process.
substitutions: 你解决的一个问题：One challenge I faced was _____. What I did was _____. The result was _____.
你跟别人合作有分歧：One challenge I faced was _____. What I did was _____. The result was _____.
你从失败中学到东西：One challenge I faced was _____. What I did was _____. The result was _____. (结果可以是失败，但你学到了什么）

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：Where I see myself in [time frame] is [vision]. I'm particularly interested in [specific area] because [reason].
sentenceFrames.usage: "Where do you see yourself in 5 years?" 不要给空洞的答案。
sentenceFrames.example: Where I see myself in 5 years is leading a product team. I'm particularly interested in the intersection of technology and education because I've seen firsthand how much impact a well-designed product can have on how people learn.
substitutions: Where I see myself in 3-5 years is _____. I'm particularly interested in _____ because _____.
I want to build expertise in _____ because I believe _____.
你的真实答案：Where I see myself in 5 years is _____.
